svg.title: PayPool end-to-end system flow
svg.desc: A connected flow from retailer request through Gemini-assisted agents, supplier negotiation, clearing, buyer consent, PayPal authorization, dispatch, delivery evidence, capture and reconciliation. Dashed arrows show supporting data and background services.
svg.text: From a buying need to a reconciled delivery — the complete system flow
terms change → release / reconcile → re-clear → fresh consent
AI proposes. Rules validate. Buyers consent. PayPal moves money. Verified events reconcile.
